[[File:Skills necklace detail.png|left|140px]] |version7 = [[File:Skills necklace detail.png|left|140px]] }} A '''skills necklace''' is a [[dragon necklace]] that has been enchanted by the [[Lvl-5 Enchant]] spell. A skills necklace can be recharged at the [[Totem Pole (Legends' Guild)|totem pole]] in the [[Legends' Guild]], at the [[Fountain of Uhld]] in the [[Myths' Guild]], or by casting [[Recharge Dragonstone]], giving it four charges. Players who have completed [[Legends' Quest]] can also recharge it at the [[Fountain of Rune]], giving it six charges. Like other dragonstone jewellery, it is one of the [[Wilderness#Member_teleportation_up_to_level_30_Wilderness|few items]] whose teleports will work up to level 30 Wilderness, while most other means of [[teleport]]ation will not work above level 20 Wilderness. Wearing a skills necklace with at least one charge while [[Big fishing net|big net]] fishing will slightly increase the chance of finding a [[casket]].{{CiteTwitter|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1574717183888072705|author=Mod Ash|date=27 September 2022|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/99014|archivedate=20 December
